video_title: BETTER FIT for Giannis: Boston Celtics or Miami Heat?! 🧐 + More Knicks title reaction | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on Spurs' errors in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: our errors, our mistakes are punished so hard that we can't have ups and downs
quotes.quote: We absolutely dominated for most of the series, but our errors, our mistakes are punished so hard that we can't have ups and downs like this so much. The ups are okay, the downs, it's the reason we lost.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Victor Wembanyama learning to draw fouls
quotes.excerpt: the next step is becoming that superstar and learning how to draw fouls
quotes.quote: The next step is becoming that superstar and learning how to draw fouls. Not allowing guys like Mitchell Robinson and Karl-Anthony Towns, even though KAT was in foul trouble most of the series, to play physical and put hands on him.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Wembanyama emulating Joel Embiid's foul drawing
quotes.excerpt: he got to take a page at a Joel Embiid's book and figure out how to draw contact
quotes.quote: He got to take a page at a Joel Embiid's book and figure out how to draw contact, like SGA has done, like Jalen Brunson has done. When your team is not scoring or things aren't going well, get to the free throw line and settle us down.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Spurs' need for a secondary big man
quotes.excerpt: if you can get a guy like Robert Williams who can protect the rim
quotes.quote: I don't think much has to change. They have a really good group, a great foundation. Obviously bring back Julian Champagnie. If you can get another secondary big, Zach Collins, I love him a lot, but certain matchups they felt they couldn't play him. If you can get a guy like Robert Williams from the Portland Trail Blazers who can protect the rim, also can stretch the floor a little bit, I think it'll make you that much more dangerous.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on Giannis Antetokounmpo's uncertain future with the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: talks have intensified over the last seven to 10 days
quotes.quote: The league believes that this is finally going to happen. I would be remiss if I didn't point out that he still could commit to resigning with the Bucks, but talks have intensified over the last seven to 10 days. He has focused on wanting to be a member of the Miami Heat.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on potential stumbling blocks for a Celtics Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: a Celtics offer has a stumbling block. Number one, you'd be breaking up potentially Jalen Brunson and Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: A Celtics offer has a stumbling block. Number one, you'd be breaking up potentially Jalen Brunson and Jaylen Brown. Number two, it would mean changing the entire structure of the way the Celtics play basketball.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on why Giannis Antetokounmpo is a better fit for Boston
quotes.excerpt: I think Boston is what they need. He needs that and they need him
quotes.quote: I like Boston for him. They need a mix. They shoot a lot of threes, they like outside perimeter play. He gives them that balance. I know you have to let one of the Js go, whether it's Jalen or Jason, because it's hard to get him without giving that up. But they need a guy like this to put pressure on the paint, be at the rim. I think Joe Mazzulla will figure out he's a great coach.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' mindset during the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: how can I be the best version of myself when things aren't going well
quotes.quote: Honestly, I think my mindset was more like, how can I be the best version of myself when things aren't going well? Because you prepare for the worst, you prepare when things aren't going to go well. And so I think as a team, when things aren't going to go well, how are we going to still be successful?

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the weight of the Knicks jersey
quotes.excerpt: I don't think people grasp the weight of that New York Knicks jersey
quotes.quote: I was talking to Josh Hart and one of the things he said that is just so memorable to me is, I don't think people grasp the weight of that New York Knicks jersey. That night was the lightest it had felt in a long time.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the Knicks' offseason priority regarding extensions
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns probably being one of the premier names and one of the bigger price tags
quotes.quote: The starting five is slated to return, but you got some guys that are eligible for extensions, Karl-Anthony Towns probably being one of the premier names and one of the bigger price tags, honestly, that this team is going to have to navigate.
